categoryJoin: LEFT JOIN public.category AS c ON e.category = c.id
dateRules: Use TODAY and YESTERDAY from system metadata as literal YYYY-MM-DD bounds in SQL
Never use SQLite helpers like date('now', '-1 day')
writeRules: category stores public.category.id, never a category name string
Updates and deletes must target rows by id only after a narrow SELECT

overrides.note: Prefer Tokens category if present in public.category; otherwise Software (17)

categoryMatching: Load categories with: SELECT id, name, note FROM public.category;
Always assign a category. Set category = NULL only when no match is possible
Use semantic context as a fallback when no keyword hits
Otherwise ask the user to confirm the category
